# Scenario: projects[].proxies — one Compose stack, two Nginx port routes to
# different services; live curl through both inbounds.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: multi proxies storefront'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
! stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-shop-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-shop-api

exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9991/
stdout 'SHOP_WEB'
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9992/
stdout 'SHOP_API'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-shop
    enabled: true
    proxies:
      - inbound:
          port: 9991
        target:
          service:
            name: web
            port: 80
        config:
          cert-issue-type: none
      - inbound:
          port: 9992
        target:
          service:
            name: api
            port: 80
        config:
          cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-shop/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=SHOP_WEB"]
  api:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=SHOP_API"]

-- .env --
